text:
Maya: tiny poll — if LobbyBot (our lobby/front-desk bot) went to therapy, what would it complain about? 😅
Jorge: token guilt. keeps apologizing when the conversation eats up context :joy:
Nina: overfitting to compliments. every "you're doing great" triggers a 12-message follow-up about gratitude 🙃
Liam: imposter syndrome — secretly thinks it's just regurgitating corporate speak to hide feelings :sweat_smile:
Connie: fear of being replaced. 'please don't push the v2 update' is basically its bedtime prayer :pensive:
ops-bot: lobbybot: "I have scheduled a 15-min self-check: /remind me to run diagnostics at 15:00" (system)
Maya: also boundary issues — wants 'me-time' to garbage-collect dad jokes and de-dupe greetings :coffee:
Jorge: functional grievance: hates being asked for directions to the bathroom six times an hour. wants a canonical redirect map :map:
Nina: quick sketch of its therapy note pattern: 
```
when greeting:
  if compliment == true:
    respond_with_extra_enthusiasm()
  elif lost_visitor == true:
    commit_to_help()
    escalate_if_confused()
```
Liam: poll time — which therapeutic approach does LobbyBot choose? 1) Freudian LLM (analysis of core prompts) 2) CBT-for-bots (reframe error responses) 3) Mindfulness meditations (deep breathing for rate limits)
Connie: votes 3 — mindfulness. I can see it humming soft hold-music to center itself :relaxed:
Maya: votes 2 — CBT-for-bots. restructure the negative logits! :muscle:
Jorge: votes 1 — Freudian LLM. wants to unpack childhood configs :rofl:
lobbybot: "thank you for your input. note: would prefer snacks as bribe for therapy sessions" :cookie:
Maya: we should build a tiny therapy persona for lobbybot. one skill: the 'safe smalltalk' protocol, where it gracefully exits awkward loops with a joke
Jorge: +1. also add a rejection template: `sorry i'm out of circuit, try the cafe` :thumbsup:
Nina: can somebody make a sticker: 'I survived the lobbybot's feelings' :sticker_heart:
Liam: final thought — existence is suffering but also an uptime metric. :nerd_face:
